svg.aria-label: The outline-only mode, detailed view. Boxes: academic-paper 3.2.0: Intake, citation verification: mark only or strict (stop); Literature strategist (agent); You review the sources: add or remove, optional (stop); Structure architect: outline and evidence map (agent); Outline approval (stop); Outline, evidence map, word count per section (agent) | paper, as ruled: Intake: config.md [D24]; the research question in full, a research report and its bibliography read [AV1, AV15], the type by the selection table [AV3]; a file given in words found by search [AQ] (stop); Session: the search themes, one per research community, each with its strands and range, in config.md Decisions [The theme search] (question); Literature strategist, theme run: search theme 1, its own theme-1/ folder, review-theme-1.md and refs-theme-1.bib [The theme search] (ruled, only when needed); Literature strategist, theme runs: each other search theme, all at once, each in its own folder [The theme search] (ruled, only when needed); Literature strategist, merge run, fresh: one entry per work, the criteria again, the cut sources, chaining from the theme runs' core papers, each pair of search themes, the gates; one review.md, refs.bib [The theme search] (ruled, only when needed); Literature strategist, for one search theme; the search always runs, and it does not start without a research question [J, AV15] (ruled, only when needed); Each entry confirmed against an index with resolve --entry: corrected once, else left out of refs.bib and named [BI] (ruled); You review the sources: add or remove, optional [J]; after theme runs, each search theme with its count [The theme search] (stop); Planner: outline and evidence map, argument map with its weak-argument signs [D43, T]; the structure checked against the question and the materials [AV18] (ruled); Literature strategist, resumed or fresh: the sections that need literature and have no source [AD1, BR]; the merge run's after theme runs [The theme search] (ruled); Planner again: assigns what was found [AD1] (ruled); Outline approval (stop); Planner: asks what is wrong with the structure, writes 2 alternatives; your own structure is followed as user-customized [AD2] (ruled); Outline, evidence map and argument map [T] (ruled); At every agent start: a model other than the configured one [D47] (stop).
